Current and prior failed requests are right-censored: their successful completion times and upper envelope U are unknown. An observed refusal/cleanup duration is not an upper bound on successful completion.

Neither a justified upper envelope U nor separate variability reserve V and measurement uncertainty Q is established; the predeclared numeric gate fails. Reusing1500ms/30% or rounding a timeout to6000ms would invent a sufficiency claim.
